The structure of MgSi is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula Mg8Si8 and 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers with 10 neighbors (4 Mg, 6 Si) and Si centers with 9 neighbors (2 Mg, 7 Si), while one Mg orbit exhibits a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors (8 Mg, 4 Si). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg and Si polyhedra.
